title: Serialize Capital Flow archive readers against partial writer rows
instructions: A-LANE INTEGRATION, one narrowly bounded reader/writer consistency repair on EXACT base_sha. Current append_observations holds ArchiveWriterLock across dedup+append+fsync but public load_observations and runner.run_once read JSONL without this lock, so a concurrent read may see half a JSON body. Modify ONLY storage.py and NEW test_archive_reader_writer_visibility.py. Make public load_observations take the SAME ArchiveWriterLock around the entire read, including existence check, and introduce a private unlocked reader helper used only by append_observations ALREADY INSIDE the writer lock to avoid recursive deadlock. Preserve load_observations signature, max_records semantics, point-in-time ordering, idempotence, append atomicity, existing lock timeout/fail-closed behavior and all other storage contracts. Do NOT add stale-lock auto deletion or change ArchiveWriterLock semantics in this task. Add deterministic no-network multiprocessing spawn/Event test: parent seeds one valid observation; writer child acquires ArchiveWriterLock, writes and flushes HALF of a second valid JSONL row, signals PARTIAL, waits bounded RELEASE, writes remainder plus newline and fsync, exits normally; reader child signals START before calling public load_observations while writer holds lock and reports result/exception through a Queue; parent verifies reader cannot complete during partial phase, releases writer in finally, joins BOTH children with bounded timeouts, asserts exitcode 0, complete two-row read, unique IDs, no partial-row error, and lock cleanup. Ensure a complete JSON object lacking terminal newline is still parseable; do NOT use missing newline alone as corruption oracle. Keep all child targets spawn-safe/top-level and cleanup fail-safe; avoid sleeps as sole synchronization. Run py_compile for modified files, targeted pytest and FULL Capital Flow pytest; only commit on both PASS and git diff --check, exact allowed paths, no network/dependencies. If tests fail, fail closed and do not push. Never touch main, private, automation/**, .github/**, queue/control/status, secrets, prediction/API orchestration/journals, Telegram, MT5, broker/execution, or Railway. This task addresses reader visibility only, NOT orphan-lock automatic recovery or cross-artifact generation consistency.
